name: Narasimha Chowdary
conditions: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Follow‑up for osteoarthritis knee and heart failure.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Reports mild right knee pain on stairs, no new dyspnoea or orthopnoea.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/78 mmHg, weight 78 kg, height 1.75 m, BMI 25.5 (obese). Joint line tenderness right knee, no effusion. Cardiac exam: regular rhythm, no added sounds, lungs clear.
IMPRESSION: Obese osteoarthritis knee, stable HFrEF (EF 38% on prior echo). Advise weight reduction; order fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, serum vitamin D, electrolytes, creatinine, NT‑proBNP.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue paracetamol 650 mg SOS, topical diclofenac gel BD, calcium‑vit D3 OD, sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg BD, bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD, spironolactone 25 mg OD, furosemide 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD. Offer influenza vaccine (patient declined). Return if: chest pain, increasing dyspnoea, fever >39°C, sudden knee swelling or inability to bear weight.

memories.text: Paracetamol 650 mg SOS; Diclofenac gel 1% topical BD; Calcium 500 mg + Vitamin D3 400 IU OD; Sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg BD; Bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD; Spironolactone 25 mg OD; Furosemide 40 mg OD; Dapagliflozin 10 mg OD.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: Cholesterol 5.2 mmol/L (<5.2), Triglycerides 1.8 mmol/L (<1.7 borderline), HDL 1.1 mmol/L (>1.0), LDL 3.0 mmol/L (<2.6 high). Fasting glucose 6.1 mmol/L (3.9‑5.5 impaired). Serum vitamin D 22 nmol/L (<50 deficient). Electrolytes: Na 138 mmol/L (135‑145), K 4.6 mmol/L (3.5‑5.0), Creatinine 105 µmol/L (60‑110). NT‑proBNP 310 pg/mL (<300 mild elevation).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Routine review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Knee pain worse on walking, occasional nocturnal dyspnoea.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/80 mmHg, weight 79 kg, BMI 25.8 (obese). Right knee tenderness, mild crepitus. No peripheral oedema. Lungs clear, JVP not elevated.
IMPRESSION: Progressive osteoarthritis knee, HF stable. Order weight‑bearing X‑ray both knees.
ARRANGEMENTS: Add supervised physiotherapy twice weekly. Continue current meds. Influenza vaccine offered and given today (08/10/2025). Return if: chest pain, worsening dyspnoea, fever >39°C, sudden knee pain with inability to walk.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Paracetamol 650 mg SOS; Diclofenac gel 1% topical BD; Calcium 500 mg + Vitamin D3 400 IU OD; Sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg BD; Bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD; Spironolactone 25 mg OD; Furosemide 40 mg OD; Dapagliflozin 10 mg OD; Physiotherapy referral.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Weight‑bearing X‑ray both knees: Right knee shows joint space narrowing ~2 mm, osteophytosis; left knee mild changes. No fracture.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for review on 2025-12-10 at 10:00 am with Dr Priya Natarajan (D03).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
6‑month review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Knee pain improved with physiotherapy, no cardiac symptoms.
EXAMINATION: BP 126/76 mmHg, weight 77 kg, BMI 25.1 (overweight). Right knee less tender, mild crepitus. No oedema, lungs clear.
IMPRESSION: Osteoarthritis knee improving; HF stable. Repeat fasting lipid profile, fasting glucose, vitamin D, electrolytes, creatinine, NT‑proBNP.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue meds, advise maintain weight <75 kg. Offer influenza vaccine (already given). Return if: chest pain, dyspnoea at rest, fever >39°C, sudden knee swelling.

Fasting glucose 5.6 mmol/L (3.9‑5.5 normal). Serum vitamin D 38 nmol/L (<50 still deficient). Electrolytes: Na 137, K 4.4, Creatinine 100. NT‑proBNP 260 pg/mL (<300).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Annual review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Mild knee discomfort on prolonged standing, no dyspnoea.
EXAMINATION: BP 124/74 mmHg, weight 75 kg, BMI 24.5 (overweight). Right knee mild tenderness. Cardiac exam normal, lungs clear.
IMPRESSION: Overweight osteoarthritis knee, HFrEF stable (EF 38%). Order fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, vitamin D, electrolytes, creatinine, NT‑proBNP and repeat echocardiogram.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue meds, advise weight target 70 kg. Offer influenza vaccine (given 04/10/2025). Return if: chest pain, worsening dyspnoea, fever >39°C, acute knee pain with inability to bear weight.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Transthoracic echocardiogram: LVEF 38 % (mild‑moderately reduced), LV diastolic diameter 5.6 cm, mild mitral regurgitation, NYHA class II. No significant valve stenosis.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Mid‑year check.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Stable knee pain, occasional orthopnoea on exertion.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/78 mmHg, weight 74 kg, BMI 24.2 (overweight). Right knee mild tenderness, no effusion. No peripheral oedema, lungs clear.
IMPRESSION: Osteoarthritis knee stable; HF compensated. No new labs needed today.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current meds, reinforce low‑salt diet, daily walk 30 min. Offer influenza vaccine (due autumn). Return if: chest pain, dyspnoea at rest, fever >39°C, sudden knee swelling.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Pre‑winter review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Knee pain slightly worse in cold, no cardiac symptoms.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/80 mmHg, weight 73 kg, BMI 23.8 (overweight). Right knee tender, mild crepitus. Lungs clear, no oedema.
IMPRESSION: Overweight osteoarthritis knee, HF stable. Advise continue meds, weight goal 70 kg.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue meds, advise indoor exercise, weight monitoring. Offer influenza vaccine (to be given 10/01/2027). Return if: chest pain, increasing dyspnoea, fever >39°C, acute knee swelling with inability to bear weight.
